lifecycle.per_direction_state: at most one pending sweep/MSS event and one active OB; active OB blocks replacement in that direction
lifecycle.pending_supersession: before MSS, a newer causal same-direction sweep supersedes the older pending sweep and freezes the then-visible opposite swing as its MSS target
lifecycle.active_zone_ownership: after MSS creates an OB, later same-direction sweeps are ignored until that zone is consumed or invalidated
lifecycle.first_interaction: the first later completed bar whose range intersects the OB body consumes the zone; BODY_TOUCH may emit if rejection-close rule passes; MIDPOINT additionally requires midpoint reach on that same first interaction
lifecycle.invalidating_touch: if the first interaction closes through the OB far edge against the shift direction, consume with no proposal
lifecycle.opposite_direction: bullish and bearish state machines may coexist; if one completed bar would produce both entry directions, consume both touched zones and emit no proposal

causality: all swing reveals, sweeps, MSS closes, OB selection, retests and proposal decisions use only completed bars visible at the decision edge
